## Ornithology Week 4 Practice Problems: Feathers

1) Which of the following taxa produce beta-keratin?

   a) Reptiles (excluding birds)
   b) Reptiles (including birds)
   c) Reptiles and amphibians (excluding birds)
   d) None of the above
   
2) Retrices have asymmetrical vanes to generate Bernoulli lift. (**T**, **F**, or **It Depends**)  

3) How are remiges numbered?

   a) primaries are counted from inside to outside, secondaries are counted from outside in
   b) primaries are counted from outside in, secondaries are counted from outside in
   c) each remige is labeled counting inward from the outermost feather
   d) primaries are counted from outside in, secondaries are counted from inside out
   e) none of the above

4) Provide a hypothesis for why plumage elaboration (e.g., the evolution of sexual ornaments) more commonly occurs in the retrices than remiges. 

5) During feather development, the follice invaginates to form a placode. (**T**, **F**, or **It Depends**)  

6) Which of the following plumage colors are producted by **pigments**? Circle all that apply.

   a) yellow in parrots
   b) olive-green in warblers
   c) brown in great-horned owls
   d) orange in warblers
   e) black in hummingbirds
   
7) Migratory species commonly have one complete and one partial molt per year (**T**, **F**, or **It Depends**)
